papers.title_en: Lipschitz regularity of harmonic map heat flows from $\mathrm{RCD}$ spaces into $\mathrm{CAT}(0)$ spaces
papers.authors: Bang-Xian Han, Hui-Chun Zhang, Xi-Ping Zhu
papers.evidence: 奇异度量空间上调和映射热流的局部Lipschitz正则性
papers.tldr: 针对从有限维RCD空间到CAT(0)空间的谐波映射热流，本文证明了其EVI梯度流在正时间具有局部Lipschitz正则性。在初始数据有界像条件下，所得代表元关于空间与时间联合局部Lipschitz。证明综合运用度量Hamilton-Jacobi论证与椭圆接触估计，建立源流形非光滑情形下的正则性理论。
papers.abstract_en: Harmonic map heat flows into complete $\mathrm{CAT}(0)$ spaces admit a variational construction even when the target is singular, but their regularity is less understood when the source is also nonsmooth. We prove positive-time local Lipschitz regularity for the $\mathrm{EVI}$ gradient flow of the Korevaar--Schoen energy from a finite-dimensional $\mathrm{RCD}(K,N)$ space into a complete $\mathrm{CAT}(0)$ target, under a bounded-image assumption on the initial data. The resulting representative is locally Lipschitz jointly in space and time. The proof combines a metric Hamilton--Jacobi argument with an elliptic contact estimate applied on suitable time slices of the $\mathrm{RCD}$ source.

papers.title_en: Brinkman's term for the steady-state Navier-Stokes equations with prescribed flux rate or pressure drop in perforated pipes
papers.authors: Richard M. Höfer, Amina Mecherbet, Gianmarco Sperone
papers.evidence: 多孔管道中定常Navier-Stokes方程，研究给定流量或压降下解的存在性与渐近行为
papers.tldr: 针对含多个小颗粒的波纹管道中粘性不可压缩流体的稳态运动，建立带混合边界条件的Navier-Stokes方程模型，边界条件涉及伯努利压力和切向速度，并分别给定横向通量或压降。利用均匀化理论中的能量方法，在数据大小无任何限制下分析颗粒尺度趋于零的渐近行为，证明有效方程中会出现附加的Brinkman项。其中，通过基于伯努利定律的矛盾论证解决了均匀界的核心难题，为多孔介质流动的均匀化分析提供了重要进展。
papers.abstract_en: The steady motion of a viscous incompressible fluid in a distorted pipe, containing several small particles of diameter $\eps^3$ and mutual distance $\eps$, is modeled through the Navier-Stokes equations with mixed boundary conditions. Apart from inhomogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions on the particles, these involve the Bernoulli pressure and the tangential velocity on the inlet and outlet of the tube, while either the transversal flux rate or the pressure drop is prescribed along the pipe. Applying the energy method in homogenization theory, we study the asymptotic behavior of the solutions to these systems as $\eps \to 0$, without any restriction on the magnitude of the data, and show that the effective equations display an additional Brinkman term. An important feature of the present work concerns the required uniform bounds, which are achieved (in the case of the prescribed flux problem) by a contradiction argument based on Bernoulli's law for solutions of the stationary Euler equations.

papers.title_en: A numerical criterion for complex Hessian type equations on projective manifolds
papers.authors: Gao Chen, Sijie Nie, Yulun Xu
papers.evidence: 射影流形上复Hessian型方程的Nakai-Moishezon型数值判据，属核心几何偏微分方程
papers.tldr: 复 Hessian 型方程是射影流形上的一类重要非线性偏微分方程，其解的存在性通常依赖于 Nakai-Moishezon 型数值条件。本文针对关联 n 次多项式为强严格右 Noetherian 的情形，证明了一个充分的数值判据；进一步，对任意次数的严格右 Noetherian 多项式，建立了统一的判据。该判据以交点数的正性条件刻画可解性，涵盖复 Hessian 方程与 Hessian 商方程，避免了额外的几何假设，为检验解的存在性提供了系统且可操作的方法，统一并推广了前人的结果。
papers.abstract_en: We prove a Nakai-Moishezon-type criterion for complex Hessian-type equations on projective manifolds whose associated degree-$n$ polynomials are strongly strictly right-Noetherian. For strictly right-Noetherian polynomials of arbitrary degree, we prove a uniform Nakai-Moishezon-type criterion. This class includes the complex Hessian and Hessian quotient equations.

papers.title_en: Spectral theory of frame flows on closed hyperbolic manifolds
papers.evidence: 双曲流形上帧流的谱理论研究属于几何分析
papers.tldr: 闭双曲流形上帧流的谱理论长期局限于三维情形，高维的复杂表示结构构成主要障碍。本文利用Borel-Weil微积分建立生成元的预解估计，避开共振垂直线，从而获得最优本质谱隙。由此给出指数混合于体积测度的新证明，将已知三维结果完整推广到任意维。该工作为高维双曲流形上的动力系统谱分析提供了有效工具。
papers.abstract_en: We prove a resolvent estimate for the generator of the frame flow on hyperbolic manifolds away from vertical lines of resonances. A byproduct of the proof is an optimal essential spectral gap property for the generator, hence giving another proof of exponential mixing of frame flows with respect to the volume measure of the frame bundle. This extends the result of [https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.08387v2] in dimension 3 to any dimension. We make an extensive use of the Borel-Weil calculus developed in [https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.14846] to overcome difficulties of this higher-dimensional case.

papers.title_en: Regularity results for elliptic equations on cones
papers.authors: Carlo Alberto Antonini, Filomena Pacella, Camilla Chiara Polvara, Luigi Provenzano
papers.evidence: 球扇区上椭圆方程全局正则性，含Laplace–Beltrami特征值最优条件
papers.tldr: 本文研究锥形球扇区上椭圆方程解的全局正则性，包括狄利克雷与诺伊曼两类边值问题。利用球面拉普拉斯-贝尔特拉米算子的第一非平凡特征值，证明当该特征值不小于空间维数减一时，泊松方程的解具有有界梯度，并借助马兹亚例子说明条件达到最优。对于一般球扇区和p-拉普拉斯方程，还建立了加权全局利普希茨连续性与二阶正则性。该成果完善了锥形域上的正则性理论，并为最优条件提供了依据。
papers.abstract_en: We study global regularity of solutions to Dirichlet or Neumann elliptic problems in spherical sectors $S_{D,R}$ of radius $R>0$ in $\mathbb{R}^N, N\ge 2$, where $D$ is the bounded domain on the unit sphere $\mathbb{S}^{N-1}$ which spans the spherical sector. One of the main results shows that boundedness of the gradient of the solutions of Poisson equations holds whenever $λ_1(D)\ge N-1$, where $λ_1(D)$ is the first nontrivial eigenvalue of the Laplace Beltrami operator $-Δ_{\mathbb{S}^{N-1}}$ on the domain $D$ with Dirichlet or Neumann boundary conditions on $\partial D$.   As an example of Maz'ya shows, the condition on the eigenvalue is sharp.   For general spherical sectors and for $p$-Laplacian equations, $p>1$ we prove weighted global lipschitzianity of the solutions, as well as second order regularity.

papers.title_en: Unified theory for regularity persistence of vortex patch boundaries
papers.evidence: 二维活动标量方程涡块边界正则性保持，含Euler与SQG，与流体几何PDE密切相关
papers.tldr: 针对二维主动标量方程中涡旋斑块边界Sobolev正则性的保持问题，本文建立统一局部理论。该理论通过轮廓方程的Sobolev能量估计与弧弦量的定量控制，适用于具有径向卷积核的一类方程，包括2D Euler、广义SQG（0<β<1）与准地转浅水方程。在核的光滑性、可积性、单调性等自然假设下，若初始边界属于H^3并满足弧弦条件，则轮廓动力学方程在C([0,T];H^3)中存在唯一局部解；更强可积性条件还可得到H^2解。这一统一框架为多类主动标量方程提供了正则性保持的一般性理论基础。
papers.abstract_en: We establish a unified local theory for the persistence of Sobolev regularity of vortex patch boundaries in a family of two-dimensional active scalar equations with radial convolution kernels $K(|x-y|)$. The class includes the 2D Euler equation, the generalized SQG equation in the locally integrable range $0<β<1$, and the quasi-geostrophic shallow water equation. Under natural assumptions on $K$ (smoothness, integrability near the origin, monotonicity, and polynomial growth), we prove that if the initial boundary belongs to $H^3(\mathbb T)$ and satisfies the arc-chord condition, then the contour dynamics equation admits a unique local solution in $C([0,T];H^3(\mathbb T))$. Under a stronger integrability condition on the kernel, we also obtain local existence of $H^2$ solutions. The proof combines Sobolev energy estimates for the contour equation with quantitative control of the arc-chord quantity.

papers.title_en: A Numerical Investigation of the Rayleigh-Faber-Krahn Inequality for Polyhedral Domains
papers.evidence: 对凸多面体极小化Dirichlet特征值的数值研究，属于几何谱问题
papers.tldr: 针对三维凸多面体上拉普拉斯算子第一Dirichlet特征值的最小化问题，该问题被视为经典的Rayleigh-Faber-Krahn不等式的多面体版本。通过支撑超平面对多面体进行参数化，将原问题转化为有限维约束优化问题，并采用拉格朗日方法求解。数值结果在假设每个顶点恰好关联d个面的情况下，结合有限维扰动与无穷维形状导数进行分析，得到了如柏拉图立体、棱柱、四面体等已知形状，也发现了具有多种对称性的非正则最优形状。
papers.abstract_en: We present numerical results for the problem of minimizing the first Dirichlet eigenvalue of the Laplacian among three-dimensional convex polyhedra with a prescribed number of facets. This problem can be viewed as a polyhedral version of the classical Rayleigh-Faber-Krahn inequality. Using a parameterization of polytopes by supporting hyperplanes, the problem is first reformulated as an equivalent finite-dimensional constrained minimization problem. A Lagrangian framework is employed for the numerical solution. Under the assumption that each vertex is incident to exactly $d$ facets, the sensitivity analysis of the Lagrangian combines finite-dimensional perturbations of the facets of $d$-dimensional polyhedra with infinite-dimensional shape derivatives of both the eigenvalue and the volume. Depending on the number of facets, the numerical results yield well-known polyhedra, such as Platonic solids, prisms, and the tetrakaidecahedron, or reveal nonregular optimal shapes exhibiting several symmetries.

papers.title_en: Admissibility criteria for convex integration fan solutions and contact discontinuities in the Euler equation
papers.evidence: 凸积分方法与熵率/作用率准则对流体方程组(含NS)存在性研究具有方法迁移价值
papers.tldr: 针对等熵欧拉方程的一般分段常数扇形子解，本文显式计算任何相关凸积分解的熵速率和作用量速率，发现它们仅由扇形决定，并分解为动能失配与内能失配。由此刻画Dafermos熵速率准则与作用量速率准则的吻合条件，并应用于Krupa和Székelyhidi构造的接触间断黎曼解。精确算术计算表明两种准则均偏好凸积分解而非经典自相似解。
papers.abstract_en: For a general piecewise constant fan subsolution to the isentropic Euler equations, the explicit computation of the entropy and action rates of any associated convex integration solution, relative to a common reference solution, shows that these rates depend only upon the fan. Moreover, these explicit expressions may be decomposed into a kinetic-energy mismatch and an internal-energy mismatch from which we characterize agreement of Dafermos' entropy rate criterion with action rate criteria. We apply this to the solutions constructed by Krupa and Székelyhidi for Riemann data whose classical solution is a planar contact discontinuity. Certified exact-arithmetic computations show that, in pairwise comparison, both criteria prefer the convex integration solutions to the classical self-similar solution.

papers.title_en: Solvability of the Poisson-Dirichlet problem in domains with boundaries of mixed dimension
papers.evidence: 混合维边界区域上Poisson-Dirichlet问题的可解性及退化椭圆算子
papers.tldr: 针对边界具有混合维度的区域，本文研究非齐次泊松-狄利克雷问题的L^p可解性。核心方法是将一系列经典的可解性刻画推广至可能退化的椭圆算子L=-div(wA∇)，从而允许边界维度不必为(n-1)。所得主要结果建立了一个统一框架，同时涵盖一致椭圆算子在Lipschitz域上的经典情形与Caffarelli-Sylvestre型算子，并证明这类问题在广泛开集上的可解性。这一工作显著拓展了原有理论，为混合维度边界上的偏微分方程提供了新的统一工具。
papers.abstract_en: We extend several characterizations of the $L^p$-solvability of the homogeneous Dirichlet problem to (possibly degenerate) elliptic operators $L=-\textrm{div}(wA\nabla)$ defined on a large class of open sets $Ω$ in $\mathbb{R}^n$. This framework encompasses not only uniformly elliptic operators in Lipschitz domains, but also Caffarelli-Sylvestre-type operators, and boundaries $\partialΩ$ that are not $(n-1)$-dimensional, for instance.
